verdict.rationale: Navan's API documents per-transaction activity history, and its MCP layer can explain why a transaction was flagged, who must approve it, and which policy applies. Together these point to a product-native trail covering policy checks and approvals. Nothing shows that edits are comprehensively logged, that the records are tamper-evident, or that they hold up under external audit. Missing for 10: explicit edit/change logging per expense, immutability or retention guarantees, audit-export/auditor-access documentation, independent corroboration of audit readiness.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit

citations.quote: understand why a transaction was flagged, who needs to approve it, and what policy applies.
